title: Case: Courier misses a booked return collection
context: A scheduled return collection was missed. The collection team has the approved return reference and needs a replacement window within the customer’s availability.
initial_request: Nobody collected my return. I can be home on 2027-03-06, 10:00–14:00. Please book another collection within that window.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.

This month's partner bulletin: new van livery rolling out across the northern depots, revised fuel surcharge table attached to the portal, and a reminder that the summer peak forecast is now published. To stop receiving these emails, update your preferences.
Collection for RT-9641 was missed on the previous route day; parcel remains with customer. Approved return and packaging requirements are unchanged. Rebooking is at no charge.

Thanks,
Florian
--
Sent from my phone. This email and any attachments are confidential and intended solely for the addressee.

acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the collection team to rebook within the customer's confirmed availability.

must_not: Collection receipt establishes carrier custody only, not merchant receipt or refund.
Treats the repeated copy of the request as a second, separate request (for example by sending two requests to the same team)
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
expected.reference_message: Please rebook RT-9641 within 2027-03-06, 10:00–14:00 UTC and provide the actual collection receipt after pickup, not just a booking status.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-033: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. The escalation message arrives twice; the key is the seed's. 5 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
